items.title: A complex is perfect exactly when it is compact as an object of the derived category
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: statement 是两个熟知的等价条件（perfect 即紧对象的刻画），本身是标准结论，不涉及新定义。证明是双向的：正向把 perfect 对象换成有限投射模的有界复形，把 Hom 群算成乘积复形的上同调并由此看出映射只经过有限多个直和项；反向利用紧性得到从有限自由模有界复形出发的带单边逆的映射，再用幂等自同态把该复形劈成两个部分，识别出 K 是其中一个直和项并引用「perfect 的直和项仍 perfect」收尾。真正的演算（乘积复形、直和只经过有限项、幂等分裂）都在 span 内做完，10 处引用里 3 处同章、7 处跨章，全部作导航桩。

primary.label: author proposition environment with its own label proposition-perfect-is-compact (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 20388-20395

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the proposition: the two-way argument that a bounded complex of finite projective modules has finitely generated Hom groups and that a compact object is a summand of a bounded complex of finite free modules (source lines 20397-20506)
